title.value: Evaluating the Integration of One Health in Surveillance Systems for Antimicrobial Use and Resistance: A Conceptual Framework
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Evaluating the Integration of One Health in Surveillance Systems for Antimicrobial Use and Resistance: A Conceptual Framework

analysis.description: This article presents a conceptual framework designed to evaluate the integration of the One Health approach in surveillance systems for antimicrobial resistance and use. It emphasizes the significance of a global health strategy to manage AMR threats effectively across humans, animals, and the environment. The framework includes suggestions for designing evaluation plans and identifying complementary tools, reflecting insights majorly from the Canadian Integrated Program for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance.

type.justification: The paper introduces a conceptual framework, indicating a focus on theoretical insights rather than empirical data.
type.quote: This article presents the Integrated Surveillance System Evaluation (ISSE) framework, a conceptual framework for evaluating the performance and value of OH integration in surveillance systems for AMU and AMR based on the Canadian experience.
